HEN UNTAN

SANTA PHILER

ADAMSON UNIVERSITY 900 San Marcelino St. Ermita, Manila College of Architecture A.Y. 2020-2021

Date:

Recipient:

Address:

September 2022 Building Officials Office, Paranaque City Hall San Antonio Ave. Paranaque City, Philippines

LETTER OF REQUEST

Dear Sir/Madam:

Good day! We are a 5th Year B.S. Architecture student from Adamson University. We are currently taking up the subject: Architectural Design 9. It involves environmental analysis, topographic, geologic, and seismologic conditions according to its legal considerations. Currently, the subject takes on macro planning. In compliance with the subject and its research requirements. I humbly request for your permission to allow me to access the following documents for academic and research purposes only:

1. CLUP (Comprehensive Land Use Plan) document for Thesis site proposal 2. TCT (Transfer Certificate of Title) document for a 5 to 10 hectares lot (50,000 to 100,000 square meters) Such documents will remain confidential. The said documents will be highly significant to the accuracy and quality of my thesis proposal. Your cooperation would be much appreciated.

Thank you for your kind consideration.

Sincerely.

Angelica 1 Muncada 5h year Architecture Student Adamson University

risting a Arevaa a year Architecture Stude Adamson University

Noted by:

ARCH DIVINIA ASPIRAS Adviser: Architectural Design 9 Adamson University
